title: Albumin modification of the AST/ALT ratio gives a small, training-uncertain increment in cross-cycle handgrip prediction
abstract: A prespecified source-standardized log(AST/ALT)-by-albumin product was tested in 4291 source and 4837 independent-cycle NHANES adults beyond flexible individual laboratory and anthropometric terms. Target MSE changed by -0.10959717 kg² (conditional survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.19395578, -0.03245177]; refit interval [-0.28771746, 0.04613463]). The 0.309% gain did not meet the prespecified refit-uncertainty criterion or 1% descriptive threshold. A simpler ratio-based benchmark had lower error than the proposed richer model. This is not established clinical improvement.
